assertions.name: three_clique_overshoots_irreducible_needed
assertions.source: with eₙ pinned on D/T/⁴He and Mₙ = k-clique counts, the bonded-triple (3-clique) count overshoots A≥5 binding (ratios 1.132, 1.197, 1.240, all >1, growing) and the 4-clique reading is worse — so not every bonded triple is a 3-body term; only the Milnor-irreducible (Borromean μ̄≠0) subset counts (reducible triples are carried by the 2-body edges). The overshoot measures the reducible over-count.

description: GAP-2 (qou-ooqh): tests the 3-body term of the body-order tower with per-order energies pinned on D/T/⁴He and Mₙ = k-clique counts of the max-contact deltahedra (tri-bipyramid/octahedron/pentagonal-bipyramid). The bonded-triple (3-clique) count OVERSHOOTS A≥5 binding +13→24% (growing); the 4-clique×e₄(⁴He) reading is worse (non-transferable ⁴He magic). REFUTES 'every bonded triple is a 3-body term' and confirms corpus Part 7: only Milnor-IRREDUCIBLE (Borromean μ̄₁₂₃≠0) triples count — a bonded triple is reducible (μ̄=0), already carried by the 2-body edges. Overshoot measures the reducible-triple double-count. OPEN: the μ̄-irreducible count (needs graph→framed-link promotion). Scope-(a), per-order pinning, no fit, no wiring.
